versions.name: Dealership website inquiry follow-through — draft v0.1 (price after pillars)

nodes.primary_word_track: Hi {prospect_name}, this is Jason with Apohenia. I'm calling because I work on what happens after someone submits an inquiry on a dealership website — is this a bad time, or can I take sixty seconds to say why I called {dealership_name} specifically?
nodes.intended_answer_type: Permission to continue (yes / not now / no), or a redirect to the right person.
sufficient_answer_examples: Go ahead, you have a minute.
I'm not the right person — you want Dana, she runs the internet desk.
insufficient_answer_examples: Silence or an unclear grunt — ask again plainly, do not assume permission.
What is this about? (permission not yet given — answer the question, then re-ask).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the person has already confirmed who they are and that they have a minute, skip the permission ask and move to the reason for the call.
mirror_variants: Is now workable for a quick one, or would a scheduled fifteen minutes be easier?
Do I have you at a reasonable moment, {prospect_name}, or should I try another time?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Casual (instructor-described: A — open posture, visible hands; B — conversational, your own natural vocabulary). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: relaxed conversational pace; say it once and stop.

nodes.completion_criteria: The person has explicitly said go ahead, named a better time, redirected to a colleague, or declined. Silence is not permission.
stop_or_skip_conditions: Opt-out or do-not-call request at any point → exit-stop immediately.
Number is suppressed or jurisdiction unknown → do not place the call at all (dialing policy, not this node).
nodes.why_this_now: Permission first: a cold call has no lead action to lean on, so the only honest opening is to ask for a minute and state a specific, relevant reason.
nodes.what_to_listen_for: A clear yes versus a polite non-answer; who actually owns web inquiries at this store; any sign they want to end the call.
nodes.source_note: Apohenia addition — the source explains a warm-lead opener only (I01–I03) and does not supply a permission-first cold dealership script (framework §2, §16).

nodes.primary_word_track: Understood. Who looks after the website inquiries at {dealership_name} — the general manager or the internet manager? I'd rather ask them directly than leave a message that misses.
nodes.intended_answer_type: The name or role of the person who owns web inquiries, and how to reach them.
sufficient_answer_examples: That's Marcus, our BDC manager — he's in after two.
Hold on, I can put you through to the GM.
insufficient_answer_examples: Just send an email to info@ (no owner named — ask once who reads that inbox, then accept the answer).
We are not interested (treat as decline, not as a redirect).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the owner of web inquiries has already been named, do not ask again — ask for the best way to reach that person.
mirror_variants: If a web inquiry came in right now, whose desk would it land on?
Who would you point a customer to if they asked about an inquiry they'd sent through the site?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Casual (instructor-described: A — open posture, visible hands; B — conversational, your own natural vocabulary). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: relaxed conversational pace; say it once and stop.

nodes.completion_criteria: A named owner or role is obtained, a transfer happens, a message is accepted, or the gatekeeper declines.
stop_or_skip_conditions: Any request not to call again → exit-stop.
If transferred, re-open with permission (cold-open) — do not assume the new person has agreed to anything.
nodes.why_this_now: The gatekeeper controls the route; asking for the actual owner respects their role and avoids pitching the wrong person.
nodes.what_to_listen_for: A real name and role; whether the gatekeeper is screening or genuinely unsure; an implicit no.
nodes.source_note: Apohenia addition — no gatekeeper route exists in the source (framework §2).

nodes.primary_word_track: No problem. Would fifteen minutes at a time you pick be easier? I'd show you one thing about how {dealership_name}'s web inquiries are handled today, and you decide whether it's worth more than that.
nodes.intended_answer_type: Agreement to a short, scheduled meeting with a chosen time — or a decline.
sufficient_answer_examples: Thursday at ten works.
Actually, go ahead now, I've got a few minutes.
insufficient_answer_examples: Maybe, send me something (no time chosen — offer two options, then accept a no).
Call back sometime (no commitment — ask which week, or accept).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If a time has already been proposed by the prospect, confirm it and move to the follow-up agreement instead of re-offering.
mirror_variants: Would a short scheduled call be less disruptive than me catching you cold?
Is there a day this week or next when fifteen minutes would not be a nuisance?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Casual (instructor-described: A — open posture, visible hands; B — conversational, your own natural vocabulary). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: relaxed conversational pace; say it once and stop.

nodes.completion_criteria: A specific time is agreed, the person chooses to continue now, or they decline.
stop_or_skip_conditions: A second "not now" without a time → exit-no-sale; do not push a third time.
nodes.why_this_now: A short-meeting alternative respects a bad moment without losing the thread; it gives the person control over when.
nodes.what_to_listen_for: Whether the "bad time" is real or a polite no; a concrete day or hour.
nodes.source_note: Apohenia addition — the short-meeting alternative is not in the source (framework §2).

nodes.primary_word_track: Hi, is this {prospect_name}? It's Jason with Apohenia — you {documented_action} about how {dealership_name} handles website inquiries. Did I get that right?
nodes.intended_answer_type: Confirmation of the person and of the actual lead action that created this callback.
sufficient_answer_examples: Yes, that's me — I filled in the form after reading your checklist.
That's right, though it was my sales manager who asked me to look.
insufficient_answer_examples: I don't remember doing that (do not insist — ask what they were looking at, and use the new-activity intent variant).
Who is this? (identity not confirmed — restate name and reason once).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the person has already identified themselves and named the action, skip confirmation and go straight to the intent question.
mirror_variants: Am I speaking with {prospect_name}? I have a note that you {documented_action} — is that correct?
Before I go on — you're the person who {documented_action}, is that right, or did someone else at {dealership_name} send it in?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Casual (instructor-described: A — open posture, visible hands; B — conversational, your own natural vocabulary). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: relaxed conversational pace; say it once and stop.

nodes.completion_criteria: Both the identity and the lead action are confirmed, corrected, or explicitly unknown.

branches.label: Doesn't recall the action
branches.note: Use the new-activity intent wording (I07) rather than the improvement wording.

stop_or_skip_conditions: Wrong person → apologise and stop; do not pitch whoever answered.
nodes.why_this_now: The source ties the call back to the action that created the lead so the conversation starts from something real the person did (I01–I02).
nodes.what_to_listen_for: Whether they own the action or were delegated; the words they use for the inquiry problem — those become {their_word} later.

nodes.primary_word_track: Before we go on — my colleague's notes say: {setter_notes}. Is that about right, or did anything get lost between the two conversations?
nodes.intended_answer_type: Confirmation, correction, or a gap in the setter notes (goal, problem, impact).
sufficient_answer_examples: That's right, and it's mostly weekends where things fall through.
Mostly — but I never said we lose deals, I said we don't know.
insufficient_answer_examples: Sure, whatever you have (no engagement — read back the three parts one at a time).
I told your colleague all this (confirmation not given — ask which part is right).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the notes already contain goal, problem and impact and the prospect confirms them, mark intent and logical certainty evidence-satisfied and move to the rationale question. Missing or disputed parts route back to the specific missing question — never past it.
mirror_variants: Let me read back what I have, and you correct me where I'm wrong: {setter_notes}.
What did you want to make sure I already knew before we start?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Casual (instructor-described: A — open posture, visible hands; B — conversational, your own natural vocabulary). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: relaxed conversational pace; say it once and stop.

nodes.completion_criteria: The prospect has confirmed or corrected each of goal, problem and impact; missing items are identified by name.

branches.label: Goal missing or disputed
branches.note: Route to the missing question, not past it.

stop_or_skip_conditions: If no notes exist, skip the recap entirely and start at intent.
nodes.why_this_now: The source avoids repeating the setting call by recapping and confirming; Apohenia adds the evidence check so disputed or missing notes are not skipped over.
nodes.what_to_listen_for: Corrections in the prospect's own words; hesitation on a specific item; the setter's paraphrase being mistaken for the prospect's statement.
nodes.source_note: Source lineage I08; the missing-or-disputed routing is an Apohenia addition (framework §2).

nodes.primary_word_track: What had you looking at this — specifically, what would you want to be different about how {dealership_name} handles website inquiries?
nodes.intended_answer_type: A tangible: the desired future result for web inquiries (a state, a number, or a change), not a biography.
sufficient_answer_examples: I want every inquiry answered the same day, and I want to know it happened.
More of those form leads should turn into appointments — right now most just die.
insufficient_answer_examples: We've been here twenty years and things are fine (no desired change stated — ask what, if anything, they would change).
Just seeing what you do (exploring, no tangible — accept it; offer the checklist and a follow-up rather than manufacturing a goal).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the prospect already stated the desired result (e.g. in the inquiry form or the recap), mark satisfied and say: "You mentioned {stated_goal} — let me ask about what you have seen so far."
mirror_variants: If this went well, what would you want it to change for the store?
What would you need to see on inquiries for you to say this was worth it?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Curious (instructor-described: A — head tilt, squint, upward inflection; B — lower the guard, first-person demonstration). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: brisker early-discovery pace; ask, then leave a full beat of silence.

nodes.completion_criteria: One desired future result about inquiries is stated in the prospect's words, or the prospect states they have no goal (accepted).

branches.label: Already described the problem too
branches.note: Do not ask the experience question again (scenario 3).

stop_or_skip_conditions: Skip when the tangible is already on record (evidence-satisfied).
nodes.why_this_now: The tangible is the anchor everything later refers back to; the source asks one intent question, not both variants (I06 for improvement, I07 for a new activity).
nodes.what_to_listen_for: A result versus a wish; the exact noun they use for the problem (inquiries, leads, forms) — keep their word.

nodes.primary_word_track: What have you seen that tells you the inquiries aren't turning into {stated_goal} the way you'd want?
nodes.intended_answer_type: The past or present experience behind the goal — an observed gap, not a restatement of the goal.
sufficient_answer_examples: Last month I found four inquiries nobody had touched for three days.
Customers tell us on the phone that they already filled in the form and heard nothing.
insufficient_answer_examples: I just want more appointments (goal repeated — use a mirror).
Everyone has this problem (generic claim — ask what they have seen at this store).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the inquiry text or setter notes already contain a specific observed experience, mark satisfied and transition: "You mentioned {stated_problem} — walk me through what happens today."
mirror_variants: What would fixing that let the store do that it cannot do now?
How is the current situation showing up week to week — what do you actually notice?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Curious (instructor-described: A — head tilt, squint, upward inflection; B — lower the guard, first-person demonstration). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: brisker early-discovery pace; ask, then leave a full beat of silence.

nodes.completion_criteria: One concrete observation about the current inquiry handling is stated; "I do not have that problem" counts as a complete, accepted answer.

branches.label: Repeated a generic goal
branches.note: Use a mirror variant once; then move on.

stop_or_skip_conditions: Skip when an experience is already on record.
nodes.why_this_now: The source distinguishes the tangible (want) from the experience (what they have seen); the mirror switches to what the goal would allow when only the goal comes back (framework §3).
nodes.what_to_listen_for: An observed event with a rough number or date; whether they are guessing or reporting.

nodes.primary_word_track: Walk me through what happens today when someone sends an inquiry through the website — who sees it first, and what happens next?
nodes.intended_answer_type: The current process: where inquiries land, who is notified, who responds, and how a response is tracked.
sufficient_answer_examples: It goes to the sales@ inbox, whoever is on the desk grabs it, and they reply from their own email.
The CRM assigns it round-robin, but half the guys ignore the task.
insufficient_answer_examples: It's a mess (a label, not a process — ask who sees it first).
The CRM handles it (a tool, not a process — ask what a person does after the CRM notifies them).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the current process was already described (recap or earlier answer), mark satisfied: "You said the inquiries go to {current_process} — how long has it worked that way?"
mirror_variants: If I sent a test inquiry through your site right now, what would happen to it in the first hour?
Who would be the first human to see a web inquiry, and how would they know it arrived?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Curious (instructor-described: A — head tilt, squint, upward inflection; B — lower the guard, first-person demonstration). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: brisker early-discovery pace; ask, then leave a full beat of silence.

nodes.completion_criteria: The path of an inquiry from arrival to first human action is described, or the prospect says they do not know (accepted).

branches.label: Doesn't know
branches.note: Agree that they will find out; do not guess for them.

nodes.why_this_now: Logical certainty starts with the current process because every later question (what they like, what they would change, the impact) refers back to it (L01).
nodes.what_to_listen_for: Handoffs with no owner; steps that depend on one person; the tool they name — it becomes the "one existing channel".

nodes.primary_word_track: How long has it worked that way — and what led you to set it up like that in the first place?
nodes.intended_answer_type: The age of the current process and its original rationale (inherited, chosen, imposed by a vendor).
sufficient_answer_examples: Since we switched CRMs two years ago; the vendor set the routing and nobody changed it.
Forever — the previous GM ran it from his inbox and we kept going.
insufficient_answer_examples: A while (no duration — ask whether it is months or years).
Because it works (no origin — ask who decided it).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If duration and origin are already known, transition: "You said it has been {process_duration} — is there anything about it worth keeping?"
mirror_variants: Was this set up on purpose, or did it just settle into place?
Roughly when did the current way of handling inquiries start?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Curious (instructor-described: A — head tilt, squint, upward inflection; B — lower the guard, first-person demonstration). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: brisker early-discovery pace; ask, then leave a full beat of silence.

nodes.completion_criteria: A rough duration and an origin are stated, or the prospect declines (accepted).
nodes.why_this_now: The source treats the origin question as a gentle doubt question: hearing themselves explain an inherited process is what opens them to a different one (L02–L03).
nodes.what_to_listen_for: "Nobody decided" — the process was never chosen; a vendor default; a person who has since left.

nodes.primary_word_track: Setting the follow-through problem aside for a second — is there anything about the current setup you'd want to keep, whatever changes?
nodes.intended_answer_type: What the prospect values in the present approach, or an explicit "nothing" — accepted as is.
sufficient_answer_examples: The CRM itself is fine; I do not want another login for the team.
Honestly, nothing — I'd start over.
insufficient_answer_examples: It's all fine, we just need more leads (contradicts the stated problem — ask which part is fine).
What do you mean keep? (clarify: which parts should survive a change).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the prospect already said what must stay (e.g. "keep the CRM"), transition: "You mentioned keeping {preserved_element} — if you could change one thing, what would it be?"
mirror_variants: If the process changed tomorrow, what would the team be upset to lose?
Which part of the current handling is actually working for you?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Curious (instructor-described: A — head tilt, squint, upward inflection; B — lower the guard, first-person demonstration). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: brisker early-discovery pace; ask, then leave a full beat of silence.

nodes.completion_criteria: A valued element is named, or the prospect states there is nothing they like. Do NOT push a "nothing" back into a positive.

branches.label: Nothing liked
branches.note: Accepted as is — no forced positive.

nodes.why_this_now: Asking what should be preserved keeps the conversation fair and tells you what the offer must not break (the one existing channel, the one handoff).
nodes.what_to_listen_for: Tools or people that must stay; a "nothing" said with relief versus with frustration.
nodes.source_note: Adaptation: the source (L06, study_only) forces a no-answer back into a positive to appear unbiased. Apohenia asks what should be preserved but accepts that nothing is liked (framework §4). L06 is cited here only as a note and is not a live node.

nodes.primary_word_track: If you could change one thing about the process or the results, what would it be?
nodes.intended_answer_type: One specific problem in the current process or its results, in concrete terms (not a label).
sufficient_answer_examples: Inquiries that come in after six sit until the next morning, and Saturday ones until Monday.
Nobody knows who owns a lead, so two people call the same customer or nobody does.
insufficient_answer_examples: Accountability (a label — ask "what do you mean by that?").
Everything (ask for the one thing they would fix first).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If a specific problem is already on record, transition: "You mentioned {stated_problem} — how long has that been going on?"
mirror_variants: What do you mean by that — can you give me an example from last week?
How do you mean — what does that look like on an actual inquiry?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Curious (instructor-described: A — head tilt, squint, upward inflection; B — lower the guard, first-person demonstration). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: brisker early-discovery pace; ask, then leave a full beat of silence.

nodes.completion_criteria: A specific, concrete problem is stated (or clarified via the probe), or the prospect says there is nothing to change (accepted).

branches.label: Label only
branches.note: Use the "what do you mean" probe (L08/L09) once.

branches.label: Nothing to change
branches.note: No actual problem — respectful exit.

nodes.why_this_now: After positives, the source asks for the specific problem and immediately clarifies labels (L07–L09); the clarified problem becomes {stated_problem} for every later node.
nodes.what_to_listen_for: The prospect's own word for the problem — pin it; a number or time-of-day pattern; a person-dependency.

nodes.primary_word_track: How long has {stated_problem} been going on — and has it affected anything downstream, like appointments kept or what your staff spend their time on?
nodes.intended_answer_type: The problem duration (distinct from process duration) and a downstream impact — operational, economic or personal — in their words.
sufficient_answer_examples: Since we lost our BDC person in March. We've probably missed a dozen appointments a month, and I spend Monday mornings chasing.
About a year. Honestly it hasn't cost us much that I can prove — it just annoys me.
insufficient_answer_examples: Yes, it has (no how — ask "how so, just so I understand?").
It's bad for business (generic — ask what they have actually seen change).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If duration and impact are already on record, transition: "You mentioned {stated_impact} — in six months, where would you want to be on this?"
mirror_variants: How so, just so I understand — what has it changed for the store?
When did you first notice it, and what has it cost you that you can point to?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Skeptical / probing (instructor-described: A — lean back, brow cue; B — leaning out, used in the first half of emotional certainty). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: slow down slightly; let the question sit rather than filling the gap.

nodes.completion_criteria: A duration and at least one concrete impact are stated, OR the prospect says the impact is small or unknown (accepted; not escalated).

branches.label: No meaningful impact
branches.note: Low priority is a legitimate answer; nurture, do not escalate.

nodes.why_this_now: Impact ties the process to a cost the prospect states themselves; in the reviewed call (A13) this was quantified rather than emotionalised (framework §4).
nodes.what_to_listen_for: Verified counts versus estimates versus feelings — keep them labelled separately; who pays the cost (staff time, the manager, the customer).

nodes.primary_word_track: In six months, where would you want {dealership_name} to be on this — say, what share of inquiries answered the same day, or how many turning into appointments? And where is it now?
nodes.intended_answer_type: A target metric for inquiries and the current baseline (or an honest "I do not know the baseline").
sufficient_answer_examples: Everything answered inside an hour during opening hours; today it's maybe half.
I'd want ten appointments a month from web leads; I genuinely don't know what we get now.
insufficient_answer_examples: Better (no target — ask for a number or a description they could recognise).
A lot more (ask "when you say a lot, is that two, five, ten?").
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If a target and baseline are already on record, transition: "You mentioned {target_metric} — would it make sense to go through this properly on a longer call?"
mirror_variants: If this were working, what number would you look at each Monday to know?
What would "fixed" look like in six months, in terms you could check?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Curious (instructor-described: A — head tilt, squint, upward inflection; B — lower the guard, first-person demonstration). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: brisker early-discovery pace; ask, then leave a full beat of silence.

nodes.completion_criteria: A target and a baseline (or an explicit unknown baseline) are stated. Neither establishes budget or affordability.

branches.label: Signals this may be too small a priority to fund
branches.note: Conditional branch only (A03); never asked of everyone.

nodes.why_this_now: The setter needs a target and a gap to judge whether a longer conversation is relevant (S01–S02); it is a relevance check, not an affordability test.
nodes.what_to_listen_for: Whether the number is a wish or a plan; whether they can measure it today.

nodes.primary_word_track: If there were a bounded way to close that gap, is this something {dealership_name} would put budget toward this year — or is it more of a look-around for now?
nodes.intended_answer_type: Whether the store would fund a bounded fix at all — a priority signal, not a budget figure.
sufficient_answer_examples: If it's bounded and I can see the numbers, yes, there's a line for it.
Honestly a look-around — we're mid-CRM-migration and nothing gets approved until Q1.
insufficient_answer_examples: Depends on the price (fair — say the price is set only after scope, and ask whether the problem is worth funding at all).
We always invest in growth (generic — ask whether this specific problem has a budget owner).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the prospect already stated a budget line or a freeze, do not ask — reflect it and move to permission or nurture.
mirror_variants: Is fixing inquiry follow-through something with a budget owner at the store, or is it not there yet?
Would this be a this-quarter decision or a someday one?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Casual (instructor-described: A — open posture, visible hands; B — conversational, your own natural vocabulary). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: relaxed conversational pace; say it once and stop.

nodes.completion_criteria: A yes / not now / not my call is stated. Theoretical willingness never establishes affordability (framework §5).

branches.label: Not their call
branches.note: Ask who the budget owner is for a later conversation; never relabel as fear (scenario 37).

stop_or_skip_conditions: Only reached via the conditional branch of setter-target-gap; never asked universally.
nodes.why_this_now: A03 makes the spend question conditional on a low-qualification signal; Apohenia keeps it as a branch, not a gate, so nobody is means-tested by default.
nodes.what_to_listen_for: A budget owner other than the speaker; a freeze with a date; "depends on price" (legitimate — price is not yet approved).
nodes.source_note: Source S03 is conditional in A and broader in B (framework §16); Apohenia keeps the conditional form only.

nodes.primary_word_track: Would it make sense to set up a longer conversation where we go through your inquiry flow properly and see whether help is actually warranted? How does that sound?
nodes.intended_answer_type: Permission to schedule the deeper conversation (with a time), a preference to be nurtured first, or a decline.
sufficient_answer_examples: Sure — Tuesday afternoon is open.
Send me something first and let's talk next week.
insufficient_answer_examples: Maybe (ask whether a specific day would work, or whether they would rather receive the checklist first).
What would that cost? (answer honestly: price is set after scope; then re-ask).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the prospect already proposed the next call, confirm the time and go straight to the follow-up agreement.
mirror_variants: Would it be useful to book thirty minutes to look at this properly, or would you rather have the one-page checklist first?
Is a longer look at this something you would want, or is now not the time?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Casual (instructor-described: A — open posture, visible hands; B — conversational, your own natural vocabulary). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: relaxed conversational pace; say it once and stop.

nodes.completion_criteria: A yes with a time, a nurture-first preference, or a decline. "Would that be awful?" (S05) is a source alternate, not required.
stop_or_skip_conditions: In an upsell setting, this is the transition to advanced help (X09/X10); never imply a credit or "no extra money" that is not in an approved offer.
nodes.why_this_now: The setter call ends with permission to connect, not a pitch (S04); the nurture-first option (B17) is offered without guilt.
nodes.what_to_listen_for: A concrete time; who else should be on the call; whether "send me something" is interest or a soft no.

nodes.primary_word_track: Besides {stated_problem}, what's the main reason you'd look at outside help on this rather than tightening it up in-house?
nodes.intended_answer_type: The prospect's own argument for outside help versus continuing alone (or a stated preference for in-house).
sufficient_answer_examples: We've tried assigning it twice and it drifts back within a month — nobody here owns the process.
Honestly I'd rather fix it in-house; I just want to know what good looks like.
insufficient_answer_examples: You're the experts (flattery, not a rationale — ask what they have already tried).
Why not? (no reason — ask what in-house attempts looked like).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the rationale is already on record (e.g. "we tried in-house twice"), transition: "You mentioned {rationale} — before we spoke, had you looked at other ways to fix this?"
mirror_variants: What has stopped this from getting fixed with the people and tools you already have?
If you did it in-house, what would get in the way?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Skeptical / probing (instructor-described: A — lean back, brow cue; B — leaning out, used in the first half of emotional certainty). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: slow down slightly; let the question sit rather than filling the gap.

nodes.completion_criteria: A reason for seeking outside help is stated in their words, or a preference for in-house is stated (accepted — no rhetorical contrast with "the average person").

branches.label: Prefers in-house
branches.note: Offer the checklist; do not argue DIY down.

nodes.why_this_now: The source prehandles the DIY objection by letting the prospect state why outside help; Apohenia drops the source's negative contrast with "the average person" (framework §6).

That's more than I expected; can it be staged?

What would you need from me to make that decision?

nodes.completion_criteria: The APPROVED price is stated exactly as the offer defines it (setup, recurring, schedule) and a decision or concern is heard. When the offer price is null, this node renders "Price not approved yet — route to scope conversation" and no number is spoken.

stop_or_skip_conditions: If the offer version is not published/approved or its price is null → do not quote; route to scope.

nodes.what_to_listen_for: Whether the reaction is to the amount, the timing, the authority, or the fit — diagnose before responding.

nodes.primary_word_track: Given how you see the value and that the plan fits, how would you like to proceed — should I send the written scope and acceptance criteria today so you can check them?

Send it, but we can't grant CRM access until the migration finishes on the 15th.
insufficient_answer_examples: We'll see (ask what they need to see, or agree a date to reconnect).
Sure (confirm what exactly is being sent and to whom).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the next step is already agreed, confirm the date and end — do not re-ask for the decision.
mirror_variants: What is the next step from your side, and when?
What would you need in writing before you could say yes or no?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Casual-confident for the pitch (instructor-described: A — confident delivery through pillars and price). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.

nodes.completion_criteria: A next step and a date are agreed, or a concern is named, or the prospect declines.
stop_or_skip_conditions: No proposal or invoice is generated by this node; the deal-control sheet and access prerequisites gate the schedule (brief §18).
nodes.why_this_now: The source re-asks for the decision after concerns are handled (O07); Apohenia makes the next step concrete — a written scope with acceptance tests, not pressure.
nodes.what_to_listen_for: Access prerequisites and dates; anyone else who must approve; a deferral that needs a real date.

nodes.primary_word_track: Fair enough. Set the money and the timing aside for a second — is this the right thing for the store, and is it the right time? And what's actually holding you back: the budget, the timing, who decides, or whether it fits?
nodes.intended_answer_type: The actual constraint, named by the prospect: budget, time, authority, fit — or none.
sufficient_answer_examples: It's the right thing; it's the budget — nothing gets approved until the new year.
It fits, but I need my owner in the room before I sign anything.
insufficient_answer_examples: I just need to think (ask what specifically they'd be thinking about).
All of the above (ask which one would stop it on its own).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the constraint is already known (e.g. "no budget until Q1"), do not diagnose again — go to that constraint's node or the agreed follow-up.
mirror_variants: If money and timing were not part of it, would you do this — and if so, what is the part that's in the way?
What would have to be true for this to be a yes — and which of those is not true today?

nodes.completion_criteria: One constraint is named (or none). Budget, time, authority and fit are independent blockers; none is relabelled as fear (scenario 37).

branches.label: Timing — deliberate deferral
branches.note: Agree a real date; no two-people identity ritual (O09–O11 excluded).

stop_or_skip_conditions: A clear no after diagnosis → exit-no-sale; there is no minimum number of reframes.
nodes.why_this_now: The source isolates value before money logistics (O01/O02/O08); Apohenia diagnoses the actual constraint first and keeps budget, time, authority and fit as independent blockers (framework §10).
nodes.what_to_listen_for: The word they use for the blocker; a constraint that is real and should be respected rather than reframed.
nodes.source_note: Commercial reframe of the O01/O02/O08/O22 lineage. The source treats every objection as having a money component and routes "fear" through four reframes; Apohenia does not.

nodes.primary_word_track: Is it the setup amount itself, or would staging it — a smaller first milestone, then the rest on acceptance — make it workable within what you've got budgeted?

There's no budget line at all this year; it's not the amount.
insufficient_answer_examples: It's a lot (ask whether staging changes that, or whether there is simply no budget).
Can you do it cheaper? (do not discount on the spot; offer a smaller scope conversation).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the budget position is already known, reflect it and go to the agreed follow-up or the smaller-scope conversation.
mirror_variants: Would a bounded first milestone make this decidable at your level?
Is this a "not this amount" or a "not this year"?

delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: slower on the concern itself, plain and even when listing options.

nodes.completion_criteria: The budget constraint is understood; the response is a staged milestone, a smaller scope, or an agreed later date. No savings question is asked.

branches.note: Agree a date after the budget cycle; no pressure.

stop_or_skip_conditions: Never ask about personal savings (O05 study_only) — use the business's stated budget position only.
nodes.why_this_now: The source tests upfront versus instalment logistics (O04/O06); Apohenia offers staging and narrow scope as the practical alternatives (brief §18).
nodes.what_to_listen_for: Whether the amount or the budget cycle is the problem; the sign-off threshold they can approve alone.
nodes.source_note: O05 (cash-on-hand/savings) is study_only and excluded; business budget position replaces it.

nodes.primary_word_track: Who else needs to be part of this decision — and would it help if I walked them through the same thing with you, so you are not carrying it second-hand?

I'll take it to him myself; send me the written scope.
insufficient_answer_examples: It's complicated (ask who would sign a scope of this size).
Nobody really, I just want to think (then it is not authority — return to diagnosis).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the second decision-maker is already known, offer the joint walkthrough directly.
mirror_variants: If it were a yes from you, who else would still need to say yes?
What would the other person want to see before agreeing?

nodes.completion_criteria: The additional decision role is named and a way to include them is agreed, or the prospect confirms sole authority. Delegated decisions are never treated as fear.
stop_or_skip_conditions: Never use the crown / responsibility / "would you do it anyway" sequence (O14–O21 study_only).
nodes.why_this_now: Authority is a real constraint in a dealership (owner, dealer principal); the honest move is to include them, not to argue the prospect out of consulting them.
nodes.what_to_listen_for: Whether the other person is a real approver or a polite deferral; what they will want to see.
nodes.source_note: Apohenia addition. Only O13 (value isolation) is cited; the source partner sequence O14–O21 is study_only and excluded (framework §10).

nodes.primary_word_track: It sounds like what you'd want is more certainty that this would work here. Is that fair — and what would give you that: a smaller pilot, or the acceptance tests in writing?
nodes.intended_answer_type: Confirmation (or correction) that certainty is the concern, and the evidence or structure that would resolve it.
sufficient_answer_examples: Fair — a pilot on one form with a clear stop date would do it.
It's not certainty, it's that I don't think we need it.
insufficient_answer_examples: I guess (confirm what specifically would need to be true).
Do you have references? (answer honestly: none yet — offer acceptance tests and a bounded pilot instead).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the prospect already named what evidence would satisfy them, offer exactly that and nothing more.
mirror_variants: What would you need to see in writing to feel this was a safe first step?
Could that be why this has not been fixed before now — waiting for certainty that never comes?

delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: slower on the concern itself, plain and even when listing options.

nodes.completion_criteria: The concern is confirmed or corrected in their words, and a concrete evidence/structure request is captured. No analogy is performed; no guarantee of results is offered.

branches.label: Wants a bounded pilot
branches.note: Scope conversation for a pilot with acceptance tests.

stop_or_skip_conditions: The worker/entrepreneur and beach analogies (O23/O24/O27–O29) are study_only and not used.
With supported_proof empty, never imply references or results.
nodes.why_this_now: The source reframes a fit concern as seeking certainty (O22) and links it to prior inaction (O25/O26/O30); Apohenia keeps only the diagnostic questions and answers with approved proof and bounded structure (framework §10).
nodes.what_to_listen_for: Whether it is certainty or simply no need; the exact evidence they would accept.
nodes.source_note: Commercial reframe of the certainty lineage; analogies and the four-frame ritual are excluded.

nodes.primary_word_track: Understood — this doesn't sound like the right fit right now, and I'd rather say that than push. If it's useful, I'll leave you with the one-page inquiry checklist and that's it. Thank you for the time.
nodes.intended_answer_type: Acknowledgement; optionally acceptance of the free resource or an agreed later date.
sufficient_answer_examples: Thanks — yes, send the checklist.
Appreciate it. Maybe in the spring.
insufficient_answer_examples: Any answer used as a reason to re-open the pitch — this node does not re-open.
Silence — say thank you and end.
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: Not applicable: this node ends the sales conversation regardless of what is known.
mirror_variants: That's fine — I'd rather we both know it's not the right thing than pretend. Thanks for talking it through.
No problem at all. If anything changes on your side, you know where I am.

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Calm and plain (Apohenia — no source delivery cue applies to exits, stops and repairs).
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Unhurried; one sentence at a time; no attempt to re-open the conversation.

nodes.completion_criteria: The call ends courteously with no further attempt; a resource or a later date is offered once at most.
stop_or_skip_conditions: Terminal for the sale. No reframes follow a clear no.
nodes.why_this_now: A no-fit outcome handled respectfully is a good outcome (scenario 5); the source's apology-and-suffering exit is not used.
nodes.what_to_listen_for: A genuine "later" with a date versus politeness; take the polite one at face value.
nodes.source_note: Apohenia addition — replaces the source's four-reframe-then-apology exit (framework §10).

nodes.why_this_now: A request to stop is honoured immediately (scenario 40); the source's four-reframe ritual never applies.
nodes.what_to_listen_for: Nothing — end the call.
nodes.source_note: Apohenia addition — immediate respectful stop; no source counterpart.

nodes.primary_word_track: Would it help if I sent {resource} and we reconnected {reconnect_window} — you pick the day? If it turns out not to be useful, just say so and that's fine.
nodes.intended_answer_type: Agreement on what will be sent and when to reconnect, with a specific day chosen by the prospect — or a decline.
sufficient_answer_examples: Send it — Thursday afternoon works to reconnect.
Send the scope, but don't call — I'll email you.
insufficient_answer_examples: Sure, sometime (offer two specific days; accept 'I'll reach out' as an answer).
What is it? (describe the resource in one sentence, honestly labelled).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If a date is already agreed, confirm it and end; do not renegotiate it earlier without consent.
mirror_variants: What would be the most useful thing for me to send before we talk again — and when?
Is a reconnect in a few days worthwhile, or would you rather I wait for you?

stop_or_skip_conditions: Check the link opens (X11) only as a courtesy — never fabricate technical trouble to prompt a click.

nodes.what_to_listen_for: A real day; the channel they prefer; whether "send me something" is interest or a soft no (both are fine).

nodes.primary_word_track: Hi {prospect_name}, Jason with Apohenia — we said we'd reconnect today. Are you still looking at the inquiry follow-through, or has something changed since we spoke?
nodes.intended_answer_type: Current interest status and any change in situation since the last conversation.
sufficient_answer_examples: Still looking — and the owner has now asked for a number by month-end.
We went with our CRM vendor's add-on last week.
insufficient_answer_examples: Remind me? (recap the agreed context in one sentence, then re-ask).
Yeah (ask what has changed, if anything).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the prospect has already emailed an update, reflect it and skip to the relevant node instead of asking what changed.
mirror_variants: What's the plan on this now, from your side?
Since we spoke, has anything moved — priorities, budget, people?

nodes.why_this_now: The follow-up updates the situation (U07) rather than replaying all discovery; interest is reconfirmed, not assumed (U02).
nodes.what_to_listen_for: A competitor decision (accept it); a new trigger (the owner asked); a polite fade.

nodes.primary_word_track: Did you get a chance to look at what I sent — and if so, what did you take from it, if anything?
nodes.intended_answer_type: Whether the resource was reviewed, the prospect's own takeaway, and how they think it applies to their store.
sufficient_answer_examples: I did — the bit about unowned inquiries after six is exactly us.
Haven't opened it yet, honestly.
insufficient_answer_examples: It was good (ask what specifically they took from it).
I skimmed it (ask whether anything applied, or offer to summarise the one point).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If they already told you their takeaway (e.g. by email), reflect it and ask how it applies.
mirror_variants: How was it for you — anything in there that matched what you see at the store?
Was there one thing in it that applied, or nothing much?

branches.note: Reschedule without guilt (U06 tease excluded).

nodes.what_to_listen_for: Their own takeaway versus a polite echo; an application to their store in their words.
nodes.source_note: Source tease for not watching (U06) is study_only and excluded; rescheduling is offered without guilt (framework §5).

Mixed. The report's useful but the handoff still drops on Tuesdays.
insufficient_answer_examples: Fine (ask what they have actually seen change).
You tell me (share the recorded counts, then ask how it feels to them).

mirror_variants: What has actually changed for you since we started — anything you can point to?
Is it doing what we agreed it would, in your view?

branches.note: Fix first; ask later.

nodes.what_to_listen_for: Whether progress is real and visible to them; anything unfulfilled — that comes first.

Nobody comes to mind, honestly.

Just use my name (ask whether they would make the introduction themselves).

delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: relaxed conversational pace; say it once and stop.

nodes.completion_criteria: A name with a reason and an agreed introduction, or a clear no (accepted the first time). Referred contacts stay out of automatic campaigns until reviewed.

branches.note: Arrange the introduction; no automatic outreach.

nodes.what_to_listen_for: A reason the referral fits; whether the client wants to make the introduction themselves.
nodes.source_note: R04 (insistence after no answer) is study_only and excluded.

nodes.primary_word_track: What's your feedback so far — and what has actually changed on inquiries since we started?
nodes.intended_answer_type: Delivered results and honest feedback on the current product, in their words, before any expansion is discussed.

Frankly it hasn't done what you said: the report is there but inquiries still sit.

Great, what else have you got? (establish results first; do not skip to the new offer).

What is it doing well, and what is it not doing?

delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: relaxed conversational pace; say it once and stop.

nodes.completion_criteria: Delivered results are stated (or their absence is stated). An unfulfilled original promise routes to service repair, never to a new offer.

branches.note: Scenario 39.

branches.note: Review the recorded counts together first.

nodes.what_to_listen_for: Whether the original promise was met; the exact thing they say is still not working.

Same-day for after-hours inquiries; right now nobody is on it after six.

Growth (ask what they mean, and what is stopping it).

What do you mean by that — can you show me on a real example from this week?

nodes.what_to_listen_for: A genuinely new capability versus a repair of the original scope; the concrete operational gap.

The handoff rule assigns to someone who left in June.

Never mind, tell me about the new thing (do not — repair first).

What did you expect to see that you are not seeing?

branches.label: Issue named — repair plan
branches.note: Repair date; no charge inside original scope.

stop_or_skip_conditions: This node blocks the upsell path until the original promise is met.
nodes.why_this_now: A new offer must add genuine value; charging to repair an unfulfilled original promise is excluded (scenario 39; framework §13).
nodes.what_to_listen_for: Whether it is a defect (repair) or a new request (change order) — say which, plainly.
nodes.source_note: Apohenia addition — no source counterpart; implements scenario 39.

nodes.primary_word_track: What do you feel is going well — and which part has been most helpful?
nodes.intended_answer_type: Genuine positives and the component they value most, in their language.
sufficient_answer_examples: The named handoff — for the first time I know who has what.
The Monday report; I read it before the owner asks.
insufficient_answer_examples: It's all good (ask which part they would keep if they could keep only one).
Nothing really (route to repair — do not proceed to a new offer).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the valued component is already recorded, reflect it and ask about the next level.
mirror_variants: If you had to keep only one piece of it, which would you keep?
What has changed on a normal week because of it?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Casual (instructor-described: A — open posture, visible hands; B — conversational, your own natural vocabulary). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: relaxed conversational pace; say it once and stop.

nodes.completion_criteria: At least one genuine positive and the most helpful component are stated; "nothing" routes to repair.
nodes.why_this_now: The upsell closer reviews actual positives first (Y01/Y02) so the new offer builds on delivered value rather than erasing it.
nodes.what_to_listen_for: The component in their words — it becomes the comparison baseline for the new offer.

nodes.primary_word_track: What do you want more help with to get to the next level — and why is that important now?
nodes.intended_answer_type: A new tangible (the next goal) and why it matters now.
sufficient_answer_examples: Phone-ups and chat, before the spring push — the owner wants one number across all of it.
The second rooftop — we're opening in April and I don't want to start from zero there.
insufficient_answer_examples: Just keep improving (ask what the next specific thing is).
Whatever you recommend (hand it back: what would they want to be different?).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the new goal and its timing are recorded, transition: "You mentioned {new_goal} — what would tangibly be different once that is in place?"
mirror_variants: What is the next thing you would want fixed, now that the first one is working?
Is there a date this next level needs to be in place by?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Curious (instructor-described: A — head tilt, squint, upward inflection; B — lower the guard, first-person demonstration). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: brisker early-discovery pace; ask, then leave a full beat of silence.

nodes.completion_criteria: A new goal and a reason for now are stated; the goal is genuinely new (not the original scope restated).

branches.label: New goal stated
branches.note: Future-pace the NEW goal (Y05/Y06), then consequence (Y07), then permission (Y08).

branches.label: Unclear
branches.note: Mirror once.

nodes.why_this_now: The upsell closer elicits a new tangible and why it matters now (Y03/Y04) before future-pacing it.
nodes.what_to_listen_for: A goal the current product genuinely does not cover; a real deadline.

nodes.primary_word_track: Compared with what you have now, the difference is {new_offer_difference}. Do you feel that would get you to {new_goal}? Why — and which of the new pieces matters most?
nodes.intended_answer_type: The client's assessment of the new-versus-current difference, their reasoning, and the new value driver.
sufficient_answer_examples: Yes — the phone-up capture is the part; the rest we already have.
Not really; that's mostly what we have with a new label.
insufficient_answer_examples: Sounds good (ask which new piece, specifically).
I'd need to see it (offer the written old/new comparison).
nodes.facts_already_known_rule: If the client already compared the two in writing, do not re-present — ask how they would like to proceed.
mirror_variants: What does the new version do that the current one cannot, in your words?
Of the new pieces, which one would you actually use?

delivery_overlay.tone_cue: Casual-confident for the pitch (instructor-described: A — confident delivery through pillars and price). Instructor-described cue, not audio-verified.
delivery_overlay.pacing_cue: Instructor-described: steady and even; pause after each check; do not race toward the price.

nodes.completion_criteria: The old/new difference is shown explicitly and the client states fit, reason and key new pillar. If the difference is not genuine added value, route to a respectful exit.

branches.label: No genuine added value
branches.note: Apohenia rule: never sell a relabel.

stop_or_skip_conditions: A "more likely to achieve" claim needs an adequate basis (UVP rule); with supported_proof empty, do not make it.
nodes.why_this_now: The upsell closer shows previous-versus-new and asks fit, why and the key pillar (Y09–Y11); the new offer must add genuine value (framework §13; scenario 39).
nodes.what_to_listen_for: Whether they see a real difference; the one new piece they name.
nodes.source_note: The explicit old/new comparison is an Apohenia addition to the Y09–Y11 lineage.
